poses.caption: Lie supine with both straight legs pointing upward and arms by the sides.
Lift the hips slightly and tilt the straight legs gently toward one side.
Lower with control, then repeat toward the opposite side while keeping upper shoulders and head supported.

jobs.detail: SUPINE VERTICAL STRAIGHT-LEG SIDEWAYS HIP LIFT, THREE equal SQUARE cells side by side WIDE LANDSCAPE, same high FRONT three-quarter view from foot end so both straight legs and torso visible. Lie BACK on thin gray mat, skull and upper shoulders grounded, eyes ceiling neutral neck, hair flat away from under skull. Arms straight by sides palms flat mat. BOTH legs STRAIGHT together knees fully extended, shoes above hips pointing ceiling. LEFT start: pelvis grounded mat, both legs vertical upward. CENTER: lift pelvis only a few centimeters by curling lower abdomen, upper back/skull stay grounded, tilt BOTH STRAIGHT legs together slightly toward IMAGE LEFT about10degrees, not lower to floor, not knee bend. RIGHT: after lowering and returning center repeat hip lift with BOTH straight legs tilted together IMAGE RIGHT about10degrees. Body/head/arms fixed, no whole body rotation, no head/shoulderstand or hand under hips, no lumbar overarch. Both legs close together all phases, slight lateral lean clearly opposite center/right, same limb lengths/model scale. Primary ABS ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED red tint over intact abdominal shirt, no fibers/rays/sixpack lines. Fine exposed grayscale arms/calves.
jobs.prompt: Correct original project THREE-panel male vertical straight-leg sideways HIP LIFT. Use LOWER SIDE-FRONT three-quarter camera in all cells so pelvis-floor gap clearly visible. LEFT start pelvis/BUTTOCKS directly rest mat, legs vertical straight together. CENTER buttocks/pelvis lifted ONLY5cm clear small airgap mat, legs still straight nearly vertical tilted10degrees IMAGE LEFT. RIGHT same small pelvic lift with legs tilted10degrees IMAGE RIGHT. Upper back shoulders and skull rest mat ALL phases, no shoulderstand/no lumbar arch/no hands under hips, palms mat at sides. Same model/scale/limb lengths and fixed head/shoulder positions. Replace red sixpack/fiber pattern with ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED abdominal shirt tint on continuous opaque black fabric, broad folds only. Fine grayscale EXPOSED muscles, full opaque shirt/shorts seat/crotch. Three equal SQUARE landscape cells, generous shoe/head/hand margins. No text.

Straighten one knee until the leg extends forward, pause briefly, then lower; finish repetitions and switch legs.

jobs.detail: SEATED SINGLE-LEG KNEE EXTENSION ON STABILITY BALL, TWO equal SQUARE cells SIDE BY SIDE same FRONT three-quarter camera/model/scale. Sit upright on full large gray stability ball with hips and knees near90degrees, chest tall neutral back, hands on hips for balance, no weight/equipment other than ball. LEFT start: BOTH shoes flat FLOOR hip width, knees bent90. RIGHT extend: LEFT support shoe remains FLAT FLOOR same location knee bent90, RIGHT thigh stays near horizontal on ball while RIGHT KNEE straightens, right lower leg extends FORWARD until knee straight and right shoe off floor at knee height. Same right leg identity, left foot/ball/pelvis unchanged, no lifted whole thigh/hip flexion, no leaning back, no standing. Primary RIGHT QUADRICEPS ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED red tint over front of fully opaque black shorts on extending thigh, no red other muscles, no cutaway fibers under cloth. Exposed arms/calves fine grayscale anatomy. Full ball/body/hands/shoes within white margins, full opaque shorts rear seat crotch.
